```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
library(PbStatR)

d        <- params$data
trait    <- params$trait
genotype <- params$genotype
block    <- params$block
env      <- params$env
rep      <- params$rep

kbl <- function(x, digits = 3, caption = NULL) {
  knitr::kable(x, digits = digits, caption = caption)
}
```

This report was generated automatically by **PbStatR**. It analyses the trait
**`r trait`** across **`r length(unique(d[[genotype]]))`** genotypes.

# 1. Data summary

```{r summary}
smry <- pb_summary(d, trait, genotype)
kbl(smry, caption = "Descriptive statistics by genotype")
```

```{r boxplot, fig.cap = "Distribution of the trait by genotype."}
PbStatR:::.plot_box(d, trait, genotype)
```

# 2. Analysis of variance

```{r anova}
fit <- pb_anova(d, trait, genotype, block, design = "rcbd")
kbl(fit$anova, caption = "RCBD analysis of variance")
```

```{r anova-interpret, results = "asis"}
pv <- fit$anova[genotype, "Pr(>F)"]
verdict <- if (!is.na(pv) && pv < 0.05) {
  sprintf("The genotype effect is **statistically significant** (p = %.4g), so the genotypes differ for %s.", pv, trait)
} else {
  sprintf("The genotype effect is **not significant** (p = %.4g) at the 5%% level.", pv)
}
cat(verdict)
```

# 3. Model assumptions

```{r assumptions}
assum <- pb_assumptions(d, trait, genotype)
kbl(assum, caption = "Assumption checks (p > 0.05 indicates the assumption holds)")
```

```{r diagnostics, fig.cap = "Residuals versus fitted values."}
PbStatR:::.plot_diag(fit$model)
```

# 4. Genetic variability parameters

```{r genparams}
gp <- pb_genetic_params(d, trait, genotype, block)
kbl(gp, caption = "Genetic variability parameters")
```

```{r genparams-interpret, results = "asis"}
h2 <- gp$Heritability
words <- if (is.na(h2)) "unavailable" else if (h2 >= 0.6) {
  "high — selection based on phenotype should be effective"
} else if (h2 >= 0.3) "moderate" else {
  "low — the environment dominates, so select with care"
}
cat(sprintf("Broad-sense heritability is **%.2f** (%s). ", h2, words))
cat(sprintf("GCV = %.1f%% and PCV = %.1f%%; genetic advance over mean (GAM) = %.1f%%.",
            gp$GCV, gp$PCV, gp$GAM))
```

# 5. Mean comparison

```{r posthoc}
ph <- pb_posthoc(d, trait, genotype, block, method = params$posthoc)
kbl(ph$groups, caption = sprintf("Ranked means with %s grouping letters",
                                 toupper(params$posthoc)))
```

```{r means-bar, fig.cap = "Genotype means with grouping letters."}
PbStatR:::.plot_means(ph$groups, trait)
```

```{r met-header, results = "asis", eval = isTRUE(params$multi_env)}
cat("# 6. Multi-environment (G x E) analysis\n")
```

```{r met-anova, eval = isTRUE(params$multi_env)}
gxe_a <- pb_gxe_anova(d, genotype, env, rep, trait)
kbl(gxe_a$anova, caption = "Combined (joint) ANOVA across environments")
```

```{r met-heatmap, eval = isTRUE(params$multi_env), fig.cap = "Genotype x environment means. Clustered so adaptation patterns stand out.", fig.height = 5.5}
pb_gxe_heatmap(d, genotype, env, trait, scale = "none")
```

```{r met-heatmap-centred, eval = isTRUE(params$multi_env), fig.cap = "Centred means: red/blue blocks reveal genotype x environment interaction.", fig.height = 5.5}
pb_gxe_heatmap(d, genotype, env, trait, scale = "genotype")
```

```{r met-anova-interpret, results = "asis", eval = isTRUE(params$multi_env)}
gp_pv <- gxe_a$gxe_pvalue
msg <- if (!is.na(gp_pv) && gp_pv < 0.05) {
  sprintf("The genotype x environment interaction is **significant** (p = %.4g): genotype rankings change across environments, so stability matters.", gp_pv)
} else {
  sprintf("The genotype x environment interaction is **not significant** (p = %.4g): rankings are fairly consistent across environments.", gp_pv)
}
cat(msg)
```

```{r met-ranks, eval = isTRUE(params$multi_env)}
ranks <- pb_stability_ranks(d, genotype, env, rep, trait,
                            include_waasb = requireNamespace("metan", quietly = TRUE))
show_cols <- intersect(c("Genotype", "Mean", "bi", "s2di", "Shukla_sigma2",
                         "Ecovalence", "WAASB", "overall_rank"), names(ranks))
kbl(ranks[, show_cols], caption = "Combined stability ranking (overall_rank 1 = best)")
```

```{r met-stability-plot, eval = isTRUE(params$multi_env), fig.cap = "Mean performance versus average stability rank. Ideal genotypes sit lower-right."}
pb_plot_stability(ranks)
```

```{r met-regression, eval = isTRUE(params$multi_env), fig.cap = "Finlay-Wilkinson regression coefficients (adaptability)."}
reg <- pb_gxe_regression(d, genotype, env, trait)
ggplot2::ggplot(reg, ggplot2::aes(x = stats::reorder(Genotype, bi), y = bi)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#2E9FDF") +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, color = "red") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Genotype", y = "Regression coefficient (bi)",
                title = "Adaptability (bi = 1 is average)") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
